column1: # Commands of the extension package "game-lobbies" (docs/PLAN-extensions.md). Same columns as scripts/lib/registry.tsv:

column5: game lobbies saved (name, Incus instance, port, game)
save a lobby: hs ext game-lobbies add <name> <instance> <port> [<game>]
column6: eine Lobby merken: hs ext game-lobbies add <Name> <Instanz> <Port> [<Spiel>]

column5: forget a lobby (instance and snapshots stay, its wake links go): hs ext game-lobbies remove <name>
column6: eine Lobby vergessen (Instanz und Snapshots bleiben, ihre Aufweck-Links verfallen): hs ext game-lobbies remove <Name>

column5: make a wake link that expires: hs ext game-lobbies link <name> [--hours N] | list | revoke <id>
column6: einen Aufweck-Link mit Ablauf erzeugen: hs ext game-lobbies link <Name> [--hours N] | list | revoke <id>

column5: wake the lobby a link belongs to; the token is read from stdin, never from an argument (the wake page calls this)
column6: die Lobby wecken, zu der ein Link gehört; das Token kommt von stdin, nie als Argument (die Weckseite ruft das auf)

column5: lobbies as name, instance, port, game (- when none)
lobbies as name, instance, state (running, stopped, missing), players (established TCP connections to the port, - when not running), port
one row for the card: level (ok, info, off), line ("2 players in 1 of 3 lobbies")
one row per lobby for the health check: level (ok, info, warn), message; a stopped lobby is info, a lobby whose instance is gone is warn
snapshots of every lobby instance as lobby, snapshot, created (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), newest first
wake links as id, lobby, expires (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), state (active, expired); no token (only its sha256 is stored); the read needs the role app-manager
what restoring a snapshot, making or revoking a wake link, saving or forgetting a lobby would do, as data (exit 0 ok, 1 refused, 2 something missing)

do it: restore | link [--hours N] | add --instance --port

[--game ] | remove; revoke; answers status done
